name: Olive Watercolor Frame
style: A COMPLETE FOUR-SIDED BORDER around the entire card, softly painted sage olive stems and leaves connected around all four edges and corners. Occasional tiny ivory watercolor flowers. Leaves are simple wet brush shapes with blooms, not detailed botanical etchings. A small champagne bow integrated bottom center. No dove.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Flat portrait 2:3 standalone christening invitation card artwork ONLY. A COMPLETE FOUR-SIDED BORDER around the entire card, softly painted sage olive stems and leaves connected around all four edges and corners. Occasional tiny ivory watercolor flowers. Leaves are simple wet brush shapes with blooms, not detailed botanical etchings. A small champagne bow integrated bottom center. No dove. Border runs around ALL FOUR SIDES, not just two corners; keep border within outer 15% of canvas. Plain warm ivory paper in middle, entire central zone x20% to80%, y23% to80% completely empty for live typography. No text, no words, no cross or crucifix anywhere, no religious cross symbols or cross-like ornaments. Refined SIMPLE loose watercolor, sparse wet brush marks, soft transparent pigments, natural slight paper grain. No dark hard outlines, no detailed drawing, no photorealism or 3D, no gold filigree. Card fills canvas edge to edge, no surrounding scene, tabletop, shadow or moodboard. Beautiful clean stationery with a complete soft ornamental frame.

name: Blue Watercolor Frame
style: A COMPLETE FOUR-SIDED BORDER framing the entire rectangular card, softly painted powder-blue flowers as simple five-petal wet brush dabs, light sage tiny leaves, flowing pale blue ribbon linking sides and corners. A tiny loose white watercolor dove at top center. Simple watercolor accents with translucent edges, no realistic detailed flower bouquets.
